description: A delegating turn on vercel, interactive (agent#14): the model calls delegate_tasks, the coordinator publishes the child's records between the call and its result, and the call's result carries the findings, in the same run; then the model answers. No delegation_requested reaches the host, and no second parent run starts. The message_progress clears at each step and before the batch, and the checkpoints of a tracked run, are left out. Written by hand from the schema.
